prompts.title: 装配作业区
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: professional industrial interior concept visualization for the BeePump 8F factory visual-signage design review, a single landscape image about 16:9, detailed high-resolution architectural visualization.
Scope: a GENERIC LOCAL SCENE to preview signage and finishes, not an as-built photograph, not a reconstruction of a CAD drawing, not a whole-floor layout. All architecture, equipment and prop counts are illustrative. Do not imply surveyed dimensions, installation approval or a chosen sign alternative.
Style: believable, restrained, practical Chinese light-manufacturing interior, clean and maintained but not luxury or science fiction; neutral daylight plus ordinary linear task lights; matte materials; realistic subtle wear and natural perspective. No people.
Brand palette on signs and wall graphics only: pure black #000000, vivid brand orange #FF6600, white #FFFFFF, dark warm gray #3E3A39. Orange is a small functional accent on sign edges and headings, never a floor marking. No invented bee symbol, logo emblem, trademark registration mark, slogans, certification, company history, customer names, numerical KPIs, dates, staff names, capacities, safety symbols or safety engineering claims.
Keep readable text sparse, exact simplified Chinese sans-serif. Show only the text specified for the scene. No invented microtext. Mutable data cells are empty; never put plausible fictional operational numbers in them.
The products are portable electric air pumps assembled using externally supplied complete battery packs. Do not show battery-cell production, exposed cells, chemical tanks, welding, pack assembly or invented special departments.
On the image itself, reserve a clean white footer strip below the scene and print the exact text "8F 概念效果预览 · 空间与设备为示意 · 未经制作安装确认" in small but legible dark gray Chinese type. This footer is essential and is part of the picture, not signage in the factory. No image borders other than this footer.
Primary request: Show how the core area-identification and workstation visual system looks in a plausible assembly-workspace vignette.
Scene and composition: eye-height three-quarter view down the outside edge of a modular assembly workbench, with a single foreground generic square column and a simple suspended rectangular sign. Limit the view to a few workbench modules and a neutral wall; do not create a full-floor plan or depict a lift or a staircase. Workbench surface has a few small matte dark portable air-pump housings and ordinary hand tools, shallow unlabeled component bins, neutral metal bench frames; none of these imply actual inventory. Leave work surfaces calm and uncluttered.
Primary sign: large flat matte black overhead rectangular board, a thin #FF6600 accent at its edge, separate orange "8F" floor identifier and large white exact Chinese "锂电充气泵装配". Smaller exact "ASSEMBLY" is allowed. Keep this large sign sharply readable and feasible as a simple physical panel, no glowing text.
Column sign: modest flat black/white column-face label with orange accent, exact text "8F" and "区域定位" in separate fields; do not invent a permanent column number, an area ID or an installation dimension.
Bench labels: small clean white fixed address-label holders, their ID fields blank. A white task-sheet holder headed "作业文件" with a few empty gray content boxes. No fake process directions.
Floor: matte mid-gray neutral floor, a single ordinary white outlined positioning rectangle beside the bench labeled exact "线边接收". If traffic is visible, use only a muted gray logistics strip with continuous yellow #F4C400 edges and white "物流", separate from a clearly white pedestrian strip with dark "人行"; no orange painted floor, no crosswalk or unverified crossing.
Visual emphasis: clear hierarchy between the overhead sign, column label, address label and task document. Avoid a huge orange wall, giant marketing mural, overhead clutter or excessive branded repetition.

Primary request: Focus on the current proposed floor marking grammar and manual cart positioning at the outside edge of an assembly workbench.
Composition: low-to-mid eye-height wide three-quarter close perspective, foreground dominated by a floor detail vignette and a few simple manual push-carts; background shows only the cropped edge of a neutral assembly workbench, no doors, lifts, full room layout or structural grid. Functional, believable architectural render, matte non-glossy floor, precise coherent perspective.
Floor design is essential:
1) A medium-gray #969B9F logistics strip with thin continuous yellow #F4C400 boundaries on both long sides, white word "物流" and one white direction arrow inside that strip.
2) A separately readable solid white pedestrian strip, dark #3E3A39 word "人行". Keep it distinct from the logistics strip and do not create an intersection, zebra crossing, stop control or unapproved barrier.
3) Beside the workbench, an off-route ordinary positioning rectangle with ONLY a white outline and exact white words "线边接收"; a second clearly off-route white-outlined position labeled "空车". Plain gray interior, not a quality-color floor zone.
Only show small manual metal push-carts parked fully within those off-route rectangles, never across traffic strips. Use blank unlabeled tote boxes as illustrative props. No forklifts, automated carts or electric vehicle model; future electric transfer equipment is not yet selected.
Sign detail: a simple nearby white board with black header and a very small orange accent, exact heading "在制限量". Below are two clearly named fields "当前" and "上限", both visibly blank without numbers. Avoid inventing capacities or data.
Do not use green/red/blue status colors as traffic markings. Orange is confined to the small board accent and absent from every floor surface.
Show the color/material relationships plainly; do not include measurements, technical line-width annotations or certified safety claims.

Primary request: A practical local visitor-arrival signage preview for 8F, separate from staff arrival and goods traffic.
Scene: tightly framed three-quarter view of a generic neutral white wall/alcove outside an assembly space, with matte black wall-mounted identity panel and an adjacent white information panel. No lift doors, no stairs, no architectural floor-plan recreation, no proposed doorway construction or change of actual wall geometry. The geometry is only a display vignette.
Black panel: exact plain text wordmark "BeePump" in restrained white sans-serif letters, with a small #FF6600 accent edge. Use a plain wordmark only, no invented icon or emblem. Large orange floor code "8F", distinct from the separate white Chinese heading "锂电充气泵装配".
White information panel: black heading exact "访客接待"; below that exact line "请先联系接待人员". Use two empty small neutral outline fields headed "接待" and "获准范围", leaving their values blank. Do not draw a floor map or direction arrows, do not claim visitors may enter the workshop or name a fabricated contact.
A shallow wall-side blank literature/document holder can appear, with no desk, reception staff, seating capacity, customer logos, certification plaques or marketing slogans.
Through a very limited peripheral glimpse, if any, suggest the neutral assembly workbench visual language used in the other concepts, without detailed layout. Keep the floor matte gray and free of orange floor lines; no visitor route extension is inferred.
Emphasis: achievable wall panel materials, restrained black/orange proportion, comfortable legibility and a calm, modest factory arrival scene, not a luxurious corporate lobby.
